title: Cheerful 2-bedroom home with free parking
description:
Cozy and stylish 2-bedroom home located minutes from the airport with off-street parking. Only 5-10 minutes from the airport, with downtown Nashville just quick drive away, this home is ideal for both business travelers and tourists. It comfortably accommodates 4 guests.

Need more room? A private guest suite (studio + extra bathroom) is available to accommodate larger groups of 4-6 for an additional $150 per stay—or included free for stays of 30 days or more!

The space
You’ll have exclusive access to the entire first floor of the house. The backyard is fully fenced and includes a covered patio with seating.  A detached guest suite with an extra bathroom and kitchenette is available for an extra $150 per stay. Reservations of 30 days or more get access to the guest suite for free. :)

PARKING
The driveway provides space for 2-3 vehicles.

Guest access
You'll enter the house via a smart lock on the front door using your personalized code. While you’ll have full access to the backyard, the storage shed and attic are off limits.

Other things to note
SAFETY
Ring doorbell camera on the front entry of the house for your safety.  First aid kit and fire extinguisher easily accessible.

Smoking of any kind is not allowed in the house.  A $300 smoking fee will be charged if guests break this rule.
